simple.meaning: בּוּזִי (Bûwzîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Buzite or descendant of Buz.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: a Buzite or descendant of Buz
definitions.full: H940. Buzi I. בּוּזִי adjective, of a people (= בעזי from בֹּעַז according to J. Derenb RŠJ i. 6 ) of Elihu's father Job 32:2 , 6 .
